strings.zh: 吸盘魔偶是非常擅长{NEWLINE}制作的屏障的精灵,{CLEAR}即使我让大岩蛇使用{CLEAR}坚如钢铁的铁头突攻击{CLEAR}都完全无法撼动{CLEAR}这只野生吸盘魔偶的屏障。{CLEAR}如果你也想体会一下{CLEAR}吸盘魔偶的屏障到底有多厉害,{CLEAR}可以跟它战斗试。
strings.en: Mr. Mime is a Pokémon that’s really good{NEWLINE}at making barriers. Even when I had my{CLEAR}Onix use Iron Head, hard as steel, it{CLEAR}couldn’t budge this wild Mr. Mime’s{CLEAR}barrier at all. If you want to see for{CLEAR}yourself just how tough a Mr. Mime’s{CLEAR}barrier is, try battling it.
strings.notes: zh names Onix here but the Pokémon shown in #18/#19 is Lairon; kept as written.

strings.zh: 你的精灵居然能打破{NEWLINE}那么强大的吸盘魔偶的屏障,{CLEAR}真的是太厉害了！{SCROLL}这样的话你的精灵也一定能{NEWLINE}发挥出铁头突这个招式的真正威力。{CLEAR}如果你有精灵想要学铁突的话,{CLEAR}只要给我1个巢穴球,{CLEAR}我就可以教给它们。{SCROLL}怎么样,要学吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Your Pokémon actually broke through{NEWLINE}such a powerful Mr. Mime barrier?{CLEAR}That’s amazing!{SCROLL}Then your Pokémon can surely bring out{NEWLINE}the true power of Iron Head too. If any{CLEAR}of your Pokémon want to learn Iron{CLEAR}Head, just give me one Nest Ball and I’ll{CLEAR}teach them.{SCROLL}So, want to learn it?{SCROLL}
